title: macOS: hv decides whether Molt stops publishing PATH to launchd, then the code follows
objective:
On macOS, `lib/env.sh` still writes PATH into the env LaunchAgent, and doctor's env check still fails a PATH-only mismatch. No GUI app gets that PATH, because each app runs with its own. hv decides whether Molt stops publishing PATH to launchd on macOS. Then make `lib/env.sh`, doctor's env check and their tests match.

Start: on hv's decision.

Source: issue 0072, its open question.
